module Test.Intro.Asset where

import Daml.Script

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Role

import Test.Intro.Asset.Role

test_asset = do
  ((alice, bob, bank, aha, ahb), assetCid) <- test_issuance

  tp <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid ProposeTransfer with
      newOwner = bob

  assetCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd ahb Accept_Transfer with
      transferProposalCid = tp

  Some asset <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  assert (asset == Asset with
      issuer = bank
      owner = bob
      symbol = "USD"
      quantity = 100.0
      observers = []
        )

test_split = do
  (setupResult@(alice, bob, bank, _, _), assetCid) <- test_issuance

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = -30.0

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = 0.0

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = 101.0

  splitResult <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with
      splitQuantity = 30.0

  Some splitAsset <- queryContractId bank splitResult.splitAsset
  Some remainder <- queryContractId bank splitResult.remainder

  assert (splitAsset.quantity == 30.0)
  assert (remainder.quantity == 70.0)

  return (setupResult, splitResult)

test_merge = do
  ((alice, bob, bank, _, _), splitResult) <- test_split

  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd splitResult.splitAsset Merge with
      otherCid = splitResult.splitAsset

  assetCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd splitResult.splitAsset Merge with
      otherCid = splitResult.remainder

  Some asset <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  assert (asset.quantity == 100.0)

module Test.Intro.Asset where

import Daml.Script
import Intro.Asset

setup = do
  issuer <- allocateParty "Issuer"
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  charlie <- allocateParty "Charlie"
  return (issuer, alice, bob, charlie)

makeAsset issuer owner symbol quantity observers =
  submit [issuer, owner] do
    createCmd Asset with
      issuer
      owner
      symbol
      quantity
      observers

test_create = do
  (issuer, alice, bob, charlie) <- setup
  let asset = Asset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 [charlie]
  submitMustFail [issuer, alice] do
    createCmd asset with quantity = 0.0
  submitMustFail [issuer, alice] do
    createCmd asset with quantity = -1.0
  submitMustFail alice do
    createCmd asset
  submitMustFail issuer do
    createCmd asset
  assetCid <- submit [issuer, alice] do
    createCmd asset
  Some actual <- queryContractId charlie assetCid
  assert (actual == asset)
  unseen <- queryContractId bob assetCid
  assert (unseen == None)
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with splitQuantity = 2.0
  submitMustFail issuer do
    exerciseCmd assetCid SetObservers with newObservers = [bob]

test_split = do
  (issuer, alice, bob, _) <- setup
  assetCid <- makeAsset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 [bob]
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with splitQuantity = 0.0
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with splitQuantity = 10.0
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with splitQuantity = -1.0
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with splitQuantity = 11.0
  SplitResult splitCid restCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd assetCid Split with splitQuantity = 3.25
  Some splitAsset <- queryContractId bob splitCid
  Some remainder <- queryContractId bob restCid
  assert (splitAsset == Asset issuer alice "USD" 3.25 [bob])
  assert (remainder == Asset issuer alice "USD" 6.75 [bob])
  old <- queryContractId alice assetCid
  assert (old == None)

test_merge = do
  (issuer, alice, bob, _) <- setup
  firstCid <- makeAsset issuer alice "USD" 4.25 [bob]
  secondCid <- makeAsset issuer alice "USD" 5.75 []
  mergedCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd firstCid Merge with otherCid = secondCid
  Some merged <- queryContractId bob mergedCid
  assert (merged == Asset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 [bob])
  first <- queryContractId alice firstCid
  second <- queryContractId alice secondCid
  assert (first == None && second == None)
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd mergedCid Merge with otherCid = mergedCid

test_merge_mismatch = do
  (issuer, alice, bob, _) <- setup
  otherIssuer <- allocateParty "OtherIssuer"
  firstCid <- makeAsset issuer alice "USD" 4.0 []
  wrongIssuer <- makeAsset otherIssuer alice "USD" 2.0 []
  wrongOwner <- makeAsset issuer bob "USD" 2.0 [alice]
  wrongSymbol <- makeAsset issuer alice "EUR" 2.0 []
  submitMustFail [alice, otherIssuer] do
    exerciseCmd firstCid Merge with otherCid = wrongIssuer
  submitMustFail [alice, bob] do
    exerciseCmd firstCid Merge with otherCid = wrongOwner
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd firstCid Merge with otherCid = wrongSymbol
  Some first <- queryContractId alice firstCid
  Some other <- queryContractId alice wrongIssuer
  Some ownedByBob <- queryContractId bob wrongOwner
  Some euros <- queryContractId alice wrongSymbol
  assert (first.quantity == 4.0 && other.quantity == 2.0)
  assert (ownedByBob.owner == bob && euros.symbol == "EUR")

test_observers = do
  (issuer, alice, bob, charlie) <- setup
  oldCid <- makeAsset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 [charlie]
  updatedCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd oldCid SetObservers with newObservers = [bob]
  Some updated <- queryContractId bob updatedCid
  assert (updated == Asset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 [bob])
  removed <- queryContractId charlie updatedCid
  old <- queryContractId alice oldCid
  assert (removed == None && old == None)
  clearedCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd updatedCid SetObservers with newObservers = []
  Some cleared <- queryContractId alice clearedCid
  assert (cleared == Asset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 [])
  noLongerObserved <- queryContractId bob clearedCid
  assert (noLongerObserved == None)

test_proposal_accept = do
  (issuer, alice, bob, charlie) <- setup
  oldCid <- makeAsset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 [charlie]
  proposalCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd oldCid ProposeTransfer with newOwner = bob
  Some proposal <- queryContractId bob proposalCid
  assert (proposal.asset == Asset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 [charlie])
  assert (proposal.newOwner == bob)
  old <- queryContractId alice oldCid
  assert (old == None)
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd proposalCid TransferProposal_Accept
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd proposalCid TransferProposal_Accept
  acceptedCid <- submit [issuer, bob] do
    exerciseCmd proposalCid TransferProposal_Accept
  Some accepted <- queryContractId bob acceptedCid
  assert (accepted == Asset issuer bob "USD" 10.0 [charlie])
  consumed <- queryContractId bob proposalCid
  assert (consumed == None)

test_proposal_cancel_reject = do
  (issuer, alice, bob, charlie) <- setup
  oldCid <- makeAsset issuer alice "USD" 8.0 [charlie]
  cancelCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd oldCid ProposeTransfer with newOwner = bob
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd cancelCid TransferProposal_Cancel
  restoredCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd cancelCid TransferProposal_Cancel
  Some restored <- queryContractId alice restoredCid
  assert (restored == Asset issuer alice "USD" 8.0 [])
  gone <- queryContractId alice cancelCid
  assert (gone == None)
  rejectCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd restoredCid ProposeTransfer with newOwner = bob
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd rejectCid TransferProposal_Reject
  rejectedCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd rejectCid TransferProposal_Reject
  Some rejected <- queryContractId alice rejectedCid
  assert (rejected == Asset issuer alice "USD" 8.0 [])
  gone <- queryContractId bob rejectCid
  assert (gone == None)

test_approval_transfer = do
  (issuer, alice, bob, charlie) <- setup
  let approved = Asset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 []
  approvalCid <- submit issuer do
    createCmd TransferApproval with asset = approved; newOwner = bob
  assetCid <- makeAsset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 [charlie]
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd approvalCid TransferApproval_Transfer with assetCid
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd approvalCid TransferApproval_Transfer with assetCid
  transferredCid <- submit [alice, bob] do
    exerciseCmd approvalCid TransferApproval_Transfer with assetCid
  Some transferred <- queryContractId bob transferredCid
  assert (transferred == Asset issuer bob "USD" 10.0 [])
  old <- queryContractId alice assetCid
  used <- queryContractId issuer approvalCid
  assert (old == None && used == None)

test_approval_mismatch = do
  (issuer, alice, bob, _) <- setup
  otherIssuer <- allocateParty "OtherIssuer"
  let approved = Asset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 []
  approvalCid <- submit issuer do
    createCmd TransferApproval with asset = approved; newOwner = bob
  wrongQuantity <- makeAsset issuer alice "USD" 11.0 []
  wrongSymbol <- makeAsset issuer alice "EUR" 10.0 []
  wrongIssuer <- makeAsset otherIssuer alice "USD" 10.0 []
  wrongOwner <- makeAsset issuer bob "USD" 10.0 [alice]
  submitMustFail [alice, bob] do
    exerciseCmd approvalCid TransferApproval_Transfer with assetCid = wrongQuantity
  submitMustFail [alice, bob] do
    exerciseCmd approvalCid TransferApproval_Transfer with assetCid = wrongSymbol
  submitMustFail [otherIssuer, alice, bob] do
    exerciseCmd approvalCid TransferApproval_Transfer with assetCid = wrongIssuer
  submitMustFail [alice, bob] do
    exerciseCmd approvalCid TransferApproval_Transfer with assetCid = wrongOwner
  correctCid <- makeAsset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 []
  transferredCid <- submit [alice, bob] do
    exerciseCmd approvalCid TransferApproval_Transfer with assetCid = correctCid
  Some transferred <- queryContractId bob transferredCid
  assert (transferred.owner == bob)

test_approval_cancel_reject = do
  (issuer, alice, bob, _) <- setup
  let asset = Asset issuer alice "USD" 10.0 []
  cancelCid <- submit issuer do
    createCmd TransferApproval with asset; newOwner = bob
  submitMustFail bob do
    exerciseCmd cancelCid TransferApproval_Cancel
  submit alice do
    exerciseCmd cancelCid TransferApproval_Cancel
  cancelled <- queryContractId issuer cancelCid
  assert (cancelled == None)
  rejectCid <- submit issuer do
    createCmd TransferApproval with asset; newOwner = bob
  submitMustFail alice do
    exerciseCmd rejectCid TransferApproval_Reject
  submit bob do
    exerciseCmd rejectCid TransferApproval_Reject
  rejected <- queryContractId issuer rejectCid
  assert (rejected == None)

test_approval_visibility_and_creation = do
  (issuer, alice, bob, charlie) <- setup
  let asset = Asset issuer alice "USD" 1.0 []
  submitMustFail alice do
    createCmd TransferApproval with asset; newOwner = bob
  submitMustFail bob do
    createCmd TransferApproval with asset; newOwner = bob
  approvalCid <- submit issuer do
    createCmd TransferApproval with asset; newOwner = bob
  Some ownerView <- queryContractId alice approvalCid
  Some recipientView <- queryContractId bob approvalCid
  assert (ownerView.asset == asset && recipientView.newOwner == bob)
  outsiderView <- queryContractId charlie approvalCid
  assert (outsiderView == None)
  submitMustFail charlie do
    exerciseCmd approvalCid TransferApproval_Cancel
